string.text: Toggles wether or not weapons with defined recoil patterns should use them instead of regular recoil.
Allows for non AN-94 weapons with rpm_mode_2 defined to also get reduced recoil when burst-fired, or also during full-auto if cycle_down is enabled for the weapon.
Appends a line to the weapon's stats card when there's no ER:P profile defined for it.
Base multiplier applied to recoil randomness.
Affects how much all modifiers affect recoil intensity.
Affects how much all modifiers affect recoil randomness.
Controls how much the screen shakes (separate from actual recoil) when firing.
Scales the max. recoil divisor for the weapon, affecting how steady it becomes. \n \nHigher means steadier.
Scales how many consecutive shots the weapon needs to fully settle down. \n \nLower means faster settling.
Affects how much the weapon's viewmodel shakes when firing.
This effect can make you glitch out if it's too high and your back is flush against a wall.

Scales how much the current player protection factor setting (read: it's just gameplay difficulty) affects recoil. \n[-20%, +0%, +10%, +20%] by default (editable in script) ranging from easy to master, Affects recoil intensity at a 0.25x rate.
Applies when below 90% stamina and scales as it approaches 10% (see actor.ltx). \n \nAffects only recoil randomness.
- Note: These modifiers start affecting recoil once their respective White status icon appears on the HUD, and gradually scale up to the chosen value when the Red status icon appears.
Affects recoil intensity at a 0.5x rate.
Affects recoil intensity at a 0.25x rate.
Affects recoil intensity at a 0.33x rate.

- Note: Reverse scaling completely changes the mod's power fantasy for a (maybe) more "realistic" look. Consider tweaking the Settle and Time to settle sliders if you plan on using this mode. \n \n - PROTIP: You can achieve this effect by tweaking the cam_recoil and max_recoil paramteres in any given weapon's recoil profile. A negative (max. -1.0) max_recoil value will INCREASE recoil as you shoot!
Makes weapons' recoil start fully settled and gradually increase as you fire, favoring short controlled burst over beaming (lame and cringe).
REQUIRES: Reverse recoil scaling ON. \n \nPrevents reverse scaling from reaching base unmodified recoil, helps with weapons that have extreme kick.

- Notes: 
 
 - Set to 1.0x to disable a modifier. 
 
 - All of these stack multiplicatively with each other.

Scales the attached suppressor's recoil modifier (cam_dispersion_k and zoom_cam_dispersion_k). \n \nAffects only recoil intensity.
Scales the weapon's current chambered ammo's recoil modifier (k_cam_dispersion). \n \nAffects only recoil intensity.
Scales recoil when aiming down sights by this modifier, with or without a scope. \n \nAffects only recoil intensity.
Automatically scales intensity so that recoil feels roughly the same at any zoom factor level. \n \nAffects only recoil intensity.
Recoil upgrades' listed bonus (i.e.: -10%) is applied multiplicatively with each other to scale recoil. \n \nThis options controls the strength of these bonuses.
Use handling upgrades as recoil randomness upgrades
Handling upgrades' listed bonus (i.e.: -10%) is applied multiplicatively with each other to scale only recoil randomness. \n \nIf this is disabled, recoil upgrades affect randomness at a 0.5x rate.
Some upgrade trees have typos (i.e.: +10% recoil upgrade / -10% handling upgrade), this forces upgrades to be treated as reductions (or "improvements", as in, you know, upgrades).

Recoil increase for not taking care of your tools.

Treats the current equipped PSU's power supply level as a factor for the recoil modifiers. \nCapped at 100%, so values above it will be treated as a buffer.
The Stronghold PSU's active power will reduce recoil intensity and randomness during its uptime, by the factor chosen below. Stacks multiplicatively with the Exoskeleton-class modifier.

REQUIRES: Powered Exoskeletons by ahuyn [https://github.com/ahuyn/anomaly-exo/] \n \nIf enabled, the recoil modifiers for exoskeleton-class armors listed in the Miscellaneous tab will apply ONLY if the player is currently wearing an appropiate suit with an equipped AND charged power supply unit.
Scales towards 0% as the skill progression approaches the Low skill threshold.
Scales from 0% as the skill progression approaches the High skill threshold.

Percentage of the skill progression at which the penalty stops applying. \n \nNOTE: Percentage as in, level 15 out of a max of 30 would be 50% progression. (By default, skills are capped to 15 levels.)

Percentage of the skill progression at which the maximum bonus is applied. \n \nNOTE: Percentage as in, level 15 out of a max of 30 would be 50% progression. (By default, skills are capped to 15 levels.)

If enabled, the weapon's barrel condition % will affect recoil the same way general condition does as per the Weapon related tab. 
 
If playing in GAMMA 0.9.3 or later, it's recommended to disable the condition modifiers in the Weapon related submenu as weapons are hardcoded to remain at 83% general condition.
